posts.title: Exporting As Many of Your Twitter Bookmarks As Possible
posts.description: Twitter Bookmarks were first introduced in 2018 , and ever since, Twitter has treated machine-readable access to these bookmarks like they’re pushing vegetables around on their plate. The export available from your “Twitter Archive” doesn’t include your Twitter Bookmarks (likely in violation of GDPR), and official API access to Bookmarks only started in March of 2022 .
